name: HEALTH
fix_description: In _transfer, the burn cooldown uses pairStartTime += jgTime (additive) instead of pairStartTime = block.timestamp. If not triggered for a long time, multiple burns can be triggered in rapid succession. Fix by setting pairStartTime = block.timestamp after each burn.
difficulty_reasoning: This is a very straightforward flash-loan-funded price manipulation caused by an obvious token-transfer bug: repeatedly calling transfer(0) triggers unintended burns from the LP pair, then the attacker swaps back at the inflated price. The PoC is short, uses only a flash loan plus two swaps and a simple loop, and does not require deep protocol-specific reasoning.
